## Chiropteal (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 NG Small outsider (agathion, extraplanar, good)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12; **Aura** fear aura (20 ft., DC 16)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 66 (6d10+6)  
 **Fort** +3, **Ref** +9, **Will** +8; +4 vs. poison  
 **DR** 5/evil or silver; **Immune** electricity, petrification; **Resist** cold 10, sonic 10; **SR** 17  
 **Weakness** light sensitivity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 90 ft. (good)  
 **Melee** 2 claws +12 (1d4+4, attach), bite +11 (1d6+4 plus  
1d6 bleed)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 6; concentration +8)  

  Constant—*detect magic, see invisibility,* *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)*  
 At will—*[aid](../../magic/spells/aid.md)*, *[darkness](../../magic/spells/darkness.md)*, *[ear-piercing scream](../../magic/spells/ear-piercing-scream.md)* (DC 13), *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)* (DC 12), *[stabilize](../../magic/spells/stabilize.md)*  
 3/day—*[blur](../../magic/spells/blur.md)* (self only), *[distressing tone](../../magic/spells/distressing-tone.md)* (DC 14)  
 1/day—*[discordant blast](../../magic/spells/discordant-blast.md)* (DC 16)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 10, **Dex** 19, **Con** 12, **Int** 13, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 20  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Weapon Focus (claw)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +11, Diplomacy +11, Fly +19, Knowledge (planes) +10, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +13  
 **Languages** Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; speak with animals, truespeech  
 **SQ** lay on hands (3d6, 5/day, as a 6-level paladin)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Echo Burst (Su)**  A chiropteal can overload her larynx to release a deafening blast of sound in all directions, dealing 5d6 sonic damage and deafening all enemies in a 50 ft.-radius burst. A successful DC 17 Fort save halves the damage and negates the deafness. The save DC is Charisma-based, and includes a +2 racial bonus.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Nirvana)  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or colony (5–8)  
 **Treasure** standard
